question: What happens if a student is absent for four or more weeks in a semester?
answer: If a student is absent for four or more weeks in a semester, their registration will result in automatic semester withdrawal for all the courses. [Source: Circular: Amendment in the Attendance Policy (08 July 2024; from Sem I AY 2024-25), p. 1]

question: When are the Minor examinations in Semester I of 2026-27?
answer: The Minor examinations in Semester I of 2026-27 will occur around the midpoint of the Semester, which is around October 27, 2026. [Source: Circular: Amendment in the Examination Policy - one Minor and one Major exam (08 July 2024), p. 1]

question: When are the Major examinations for Semester I 2026-27?
